items.html: And the matter is that when the reflected light entered within the inner Mochin, then these four lights shone there within, and were clothed in that Dalet, which is the Malchut of Ima. Therefore it is called Dalet, corresponding to these four lights clothed within it. Then their illumination pierced outward at the nape, and there was made that knot of the head Tefillin, and there is revealed the aspect of that Malchut of Ima, and within it are clothed the four lights mentioned, of the four Mochin.
